description: List recent private Instavar video projects after the user links their account. Returns the currently resolved workspace in accountContext; billing details are included only with billing.read permission. Follow billing.draftCreditCheck: for a shortfall, explain the missing credits, link to billing, preserve the accepted design and do not request creation confirmation until a fresh check shows enough credits. Recorded credits are a read-only snapshot, not a reservation or render eligibility guarantee. Use this before review_video_project when the user has not supplied a project ID. Do not infer current workspace or allowance from an older job.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. For a new plan, omit this field on account reads and creation so the server resolves the account default, preferring an accessible bound personal workspace. A workspace ID returned by a read identifies the resolved workspace; it is not a user selection. Supply this field only for a user-selected workspace or the workspace of an existing saved project. Ask only if the server requires selection. Never fall back after denied access.
